test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: PCA (supervisory tools to maintain the sound financial health of banks) stands for:
solution:
__
 
• PCA Stands for **Prompt corrective action.__**
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India** has issued a Prompt Corrective Action framework to maintain the sound financial health of banks.
 
• It facilitates banks in breach of risk thresholds for identified areas of monitoring, such as asset quality, capital, and profitability, to take corrective measures.
 
• The RBI, through the corrective framework, encourages banks to abstain from riskier activities.
